user.title: Add a camera
user.description: Plays white, pink or ocean noise through a camera's own speaker. Enter the camera's address - Camera Noise works out what kind of camera it is.

data_description.name: What to call it, for example Nursery.
data_description.address: Its IP address, for example 192.168.1.20. If you know its RTSP stream address (rtsp://...), you can enter that instead.

tapo.title: This is a Tapo camera
tapo.description:
{name} ({host}) is a TP-Link Tapo camera. Tapo cameras need your TP-Link account password to use their speaker. It's checked by the camera on your network and never sent anywhere else.

Third-Party Compatibility must also be on in the Tapo app, under Me > Tapo Lab.

login.title: Camera login
login.description: Enter the username and password for {name} ({host}) - the camera's own login, the one you would use for its video.

data_description.stream_url: The camera didn't say what its stream address is. Enter it, for example rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/stream1.

reconfigure.title: Update the camera
reconfigure.description: Change the camera's address or login. Leave a password blank to keep the one already saved.

error.invalid_address: Enter an IP address, or an address starting rtsp://
error.invalid_url: That isn't an RTSP address. It should start rtsp://
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the camera. Check the address and that it's on this network.
error.invalid_auth: The camera refused the username or password.
error.no_stream_address: The camera didn't say what its stream address is - enter it below.
error.no_backchannel: The camera didn't offer a speaker this can use. Not every camera with a speaker supports the standard way of sending it audio.
error.not_tapo: That address doesn't answer like a Tapo camera.
error.third_party: The camera refused the password. Check it, and that Third-Party Compatibility is on in the Tapo app (Me > Tapo Lab).
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The log has the detail.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The camera's details have been updated.
